scope: Descriptive first200 protein comparisons against NT20 as well as NT24, plus fixed reference human-infection annotations on the already defined species support thresholds1,2,3.
selection: All fixed first200samples and allprotein candidates; no NR outcome available when specified.
interpretation: Separate added original reads, exact complete-pair keys, sample-species evidence, and human-annotated taxa. No new infection or sensitivity claim. No new evidence thresholds.
NR_query_context: Diagnostic reads are searched within the larger frozen817744-query pool. Query-pool equivalence to a standalone search is not assumed; exact-query dedup previously changed raw alignment output for2reads in a single-volume test.
